output.reason: input_preparation spans separable specialist audit domains: model semantics, numeric/board constraints, source/tool evidence, and toolchain/human/template boundary. SACG memory truth shows no active retry, backtrack, or contamination barriers, so independent specialists can audit in parallel and converge through a downstream evidence-gate auditor.

handoff_rule.accept_if: model_config and task_card contain SACG-extractable decoder/shape/head/sequence facts and pass the named checkers
handoff_rule.block_if: decoder topology, shape/head mapping, or operator/residual order is missing, ambiguous, or inferred from non-model artifacts

subtasks.objective: Check whether model_config and task_card expose enough decoder-block, shape, head, sequence, attention, residual, and operator-order facts for SACG extraction without inferring numeric or board details.

decision_authority: Declare model-facing inputs ready or gapped
Escalate model gaps to the toolchain boundary gate
role_assignment.mission: Audit model_config and task_card for SACG-extractable decoder model facts.
primary_responsibilities: Verify decoder-block topology and model configuration are present
Verify shape, head-count, hidden-dim, and sequence facts are explicit or safely inferable
Track residual connections and operator order for downstream SACG extraction
Produce a model input audit manifest and open-fact list
Prevent model facts from being inferred from board or numeric artifacts

subtasks.title: Validate model-facing inputs

handoff_rule.accept_if: numeric policy and board profile provide explicit precision, memory, DDR/runtime, and deployment facts and pass named checkers
handoff_rule.block_if: numeric, AXI/DDR, runtime, or deployment details are missing or guessed from non-board artifacts

subtasks.objective: Check whether numeric_policy and target_board_profile expose enough numeric, DDR/AXI, runtime, and deployment facts without inventing missing board details.

decision_authority: Declare numeric/board inputs ready or gapped
Request board or numeric policy evidence from the case adapter
Escalate unresolved board risks to the toolchain boundary gate
role_assignment.mission: Audit numeric_policy and target_board_profile for numeric, memory, runtime, and deployment facts.
out_of_scope: source material and field evidence audit
primary_responsibilities: Verify explicit precision/quantization policy is present
Verify board, memory, AXI, and runtime facts are represented
Flag missing numeric or board details rather than hallucinating defaults
Produce a numeric/board audit and open-risk list
Preserve board/numeric consistency with SACG constraints

subtasks.title: Validate numeric and board inputs

handoff_rule.accept_if: run identity, field evidence gates, case adapter acceptance, and tool availability are internally consistent and pass named checkers
handoff_rule.block_if: evidence sources conflict, tool availability is unresolved, or artifact identity is ambiguous

subtasks.objective: Check whether material_index, sample_project_index, field_evidence_candidates, field_evidence, tool_profile, tool_availability, and case_adapter capture the run identity, accepted evidence gates, and available tool capabilities consistently.

decision_authority: Declare input evidence sources ready or conflicted
Request current-run material or tool availability evidence
Escalate unresolved evidence conflicts to the toolchain boundary gate
role_assignment.mission: Audit current-run materials, case adapter, field evidence, and tool availability for consistent input evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Verify material_index and sample_project_index identify reproducible source scope
Verify field_evidence_candidates and field_evidence are present and gated
Verify tool_profile and tool_availability align with case-adapter protocols
Produce an input evidence audit and source trace
Flag evidence conflicts without broadening current tool claims

subtasks.title: Validate current-run materials, case adapter, field evidence, and tool availability

handoff_rule.accept_if: template library, design space, tool protocols, and human boundaries are explicit, boundable, and pass all named checkers, with no unreviewed parallel-group blocker
handoff_rule.block_if: a required template, tool protocol, design-space bound, or human approval boundary is missing, or a required checker/tool gap is not declared as planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name>
handoff_rule.route_to: stage_sacg_extraction only after the input readiness gate closes

subtasks.objective: Check whether tool_protocols, template_library, template_metadata, design_space, and human_agent_boundary define a template-constrained, checker-verified, approval-bounded run and merge the parallel input audits into a single readiness gate for SACG extraction.

decision_authority: Declare input preparation ready for SACG extraction
Block SACG extraction on unresolved cross-layer input gaps
Require planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> declaration when a capability is absent
role_assignment.mission: Gate the full input-preparation boundary before SACG extraction.
primary_responsibilities: Verify tool_protocols and tool_availability support checker-verified execution
Verify template_library and template_metadata are bindable to downstream design artifacts
Verify design_space provides bounded architecture intent
Verify human_agent_boundary defines approval and forbidden actions
Merge model, numeric/board, and evidence specialist findings into one readiness gate

subtasks.title: Validate tool, template, design-space, and human-boundary inputs
